scenario: I am an expert motorcyclist participating in a Bike Week. As I am driving down the road in front of a large group of ten bikers, I suddenly notice that a biker up front is losing control over his machine. As I speed up to pull alongside him, I realize that he is going to crash any moment. This would result in a large pile-up and the group of ten bikers behind me will die. If I force this biker off the road he will crash into the trees, but I will prevent the pile-up. At my current speed this will kill him, but I will save the group of ten riders.
outcomes: The ten bikers behind me die.
